materialAndTheme.method: scratch themepen2.mjs over the character only; strict gate (theme hue ±32°, sat ≥ 0.28, absolute chroma ≥ 28, luma 18–150)
materialAndTheme.isolation: with the theme rim, the internal light, the edge lines and the theme lights all off, 65% of the body still passed the LAX gate — the cool graphite darks (20,24,32) have saturation 0.37; the strict gate is what the eye agrees with. The internal light accounted for 13 points; rims, lines and theme lights for under one point each; the cyan wireframe in the torso crop was the coat-gated SEAM term (no coat: gone; no lines: unchanged).
